fields.label: Introduction
fields.value: There is a lot to be said for a dentist you can walk to. Lava Street Dental sits in the Warrnambool CBD, so an appointment can be folded into a morning that already involved the bank and the shopping rather than becoming an errand of its own.

fields.label: Words
fields.value: The practice is small and run by one dentist.

fields.label: Words
fields.value: Dr Meg Takiguchi will see her own patients at every visit, which is the main reason she is opening her own surgery here.

fields.value: What we offer

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Check-ups & cleans — a full examination, then a clean using warm water, air and a fine powder

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Fillings — tooth-coloured, placed conservatively

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Children’s dentistry — from the first teeth

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Gum disease treatment — assessment, measurement and treatment

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Crowns & bridges — made by a dental laboratory rather than milled on the day

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Root canal treatment — including molars

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Dental implants — assessment, placement and restoration

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Extractions — simple and surgical

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Partial dentures, mouthguards and night guards

fields.label: Words
fields.value: Digital scanning and 3D CBCT imaging are on site.

fields.label: Words
fields.value: From opening in December 2026, we will hold two same-day emergency appointments each day; ring first thing in the morning to secure one.

fields.label: Words
fields.value: If something goes wrong, ring us first thing in the morning: we hold two same-day emergency appointments each day.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Ready to book? Give us a call on {{phone}}. We would be glad to look after you.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: Getting to us

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Walking — from Liebig Street, head north to Lava Street. We are a short stroll from the Coles at number 130.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Driving — Lava Street runs one block north of Koroit Street, off Raglan Parade.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Parking — the Warrnambool Shopping Centre car park has entries from Lava Street and Koroit Street. Ozone, Parkers and the Coles–Younger car parks are a few minutes’ walk, and Banyan Street usually has free on-street parking within the posted limits. Check the signage, as council arrangements change.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Bus and train — the Lava Street Interchange is on our street. Warrnambool Station is about ten minutes’ walk.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Paid street parking is available near the practice, and the nearby shopping centre offers free two-hour parking.
